# Source-attribution corrections

These corrections concern explanatory source attribution and historical figure
footnotes only. Frozen task inputs, agent responses, grades, and aggregates are
unchanged. References inside recorded trajectories are historical outputs, not
independently endorsed citations.

- **MHC-II regulation:** the inventory's Meissner et al. (2010), PMID 20639463,
  concerns NLRC5 and MHC **class I**, not CIITA and class II. The appropriate
  construct-level reference is Steimle et al., *Complementation cloning of an
  MHC class II transactivator mutated in hereditary MHC class II deficiency (or
  bare lymphocyte syndrome)*, Cell 75, 135–146 (1993),
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8402893/. This supports coordinated class-II
  regulation, not the truth of the benchmark's injected biological outcome.
- **Enhancer evolution:** Pollard et al. (2006), PMID 16915236, concerns the
  HAR1 RNA gene and should not support the inventory's enhancer claim. Retain
  Villar et al., *Enhancer evolution across 20 mammalian species*, Cell (2015),
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25635462/, for that claim.
- **Historical six-model footnotes:** the original T01/T08 builders retain
  six-model audit counts. Those are not current eight-model evaluation totals.
  Use finalized eight-model exports and `reproduce_current_results.py` for
  current results. The paper inventory removes these obsolete roster footnotes.

All other source-specific qualifications in `DATA_SOURCES_AND_LICENSES.md` and
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` remain in effect.
